title: Delta weight-and-balance outage, Nov 22, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Delta Air Lines, the FAA, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: More than 1,300 Delta flights were delayed on Nov 22, per ABC citing Delta, during the start of Thanksgiving travel. Delta says about 5,000 flights were scheduled that day.
who_is_affected: Delta and Delta Connection passengers on Sunday, Nov 22, mainly at Atlanta and on flights into it. Delta says it is rebooking customers and offering meals, hotels and refunds.

known.text: Delta's weight-and-balance automation system went down on Sunday, Nov 22; crews used manual workarounds.
The FAA stopped Atlanta-bound Delta flights at Delta's request, then eased it to a Delta-only delay just after 8:40 AM ET.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Delta gives no cause.
Whether a cyberattack was involved. No official statement addresses it either way.
Whether it relates to the FAA's Nov 13 ground stop or United's Nov 16 outage.
